title: OpenUI language core, verified in a real browser

checks.name: evaluated program renders in the host
checks.detail: Card title "互动测试" then "count 3" and "item 0/1/2". Those are @Count, @Format, @Range and @Each results, not literal text.

checks.name: bound Slider is interactive
checks.detail: input[type=range] reports disabled=false, min=1 max=6 value=3. Before this stage it was rendered disabled:true.

checks.name: a control changes OTHER components
checks.detail: Dragging the slider 3 -> 6 changed the sibling Text from "count 3" to "count 6" and the @Each output from 3 rows (row 0..2) to 6 rows (row 0..5).

checks.name: replay after reload
checks.detail: Both cards reappear from the persisted meta with no model call. BUT $state is not persisted: the slider returns to its default 3.
checks.gap: Card state persistence is not implemented. A reload re-evaluates from defaults.

notVerified: Button action steps (@Set/@Reset/@OpenUrl) are still inert: the table renders a Button but no action wiring exists yet.
Only Slider writes state back. Input, Select, Checkbox, RadioGroup and DatePicker are not in the component table yet (8 of 48 render).
B05 streaming preview and B10 session switching remain from phase 1.
